body:
Atlas Legacy Advisors has announced that the Eddy Investment Group, a multi-family office team serving high-net-worth families, has joined the firm, expanding Atlas’ family office capabilities while bringing the firm’s assets under management to more than $1 billion.

Atlas Legacy Advisors is an independent multi-family office providing high-net-worth families, business owners, executives, entrepreneurs, and athletes and entertainers, wealth management and multigenerational planning expertise, including comprehensive financial and estate planning and investment management.

The Eddy Investment Group helps successful families protect and grow their wealth through comprehensive financial planning and investment management. The team will continue to serve clients from its Redondo Beach, Calif., office, expanding Atlas’ presence in Southern California. Atlas now has three offices across California.
